text: Dyads Series is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts Candid & Credible Dual Guns. It is obtained as a reward for completing the Normal Mission That's In-Credible!. The Dyads weapons available in-game are: * Storm Dyads * Soldier Dyads * Warrior Dyads * Ophidian Dyads * Destroyer Dyads * Striker Dyads * Delta Dyads * Original Dyads * Cosmic Dyads * Nebulan Dyads

Dyads III Series is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts Candid & Credible Dual Guns. It is obtained as a reward for completing the Normal Mission Pack It In. The Dyads III weapons available in-game are: * Storm Dyads III * Soldier Dyads III * Warrior Dyads III * Ophidian Dyads III * Destroyer Dyads III * Striker Dyads III * Delta Dyads III * Original Dyads III * Cosmic Dyads III * Nebulan Dyads III * Ultra Nebulan Dyads III

Dyads II Series is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts Candid & Credible Dual Guns. It is obtained as a reward for completing the Normal Mission Gorkwa Games. The Dyads II weapons available in-game are: * Storm Dyads II * Soldier Dyads II * Warrior Dyads II * Ophidian Dyads II * Destroyer Dyads II * Striker Dyads II * Delta Dyads II * Original Dyads II * Cosmic Dyads II * Nebulan Dyads II

Edges II Series is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts Six Stars Dual Swords. It is obtained as a reward for completing the Normal Mission The Duel (Part III). The Edge II weapons available in-game are: * Audacious Edges II * Faithful Edges II * Intrepid Edges II * Masterstroke Edges II * Pulverizing Edges II * Steelbreaker Edges II * Godbreaker Edges II * Phenomenon Edges II

Edges Series is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts Six Stars Dual Swords. It is obtained as a reward for completing the Normal Mission Until the End. The Edge weapons available in-game are: * Audacious Edges * Faithful Edges * Intrepid Edges * Masterstroke Edges * Pulverizing Edges * Steelbreaker Edges * Godbreaker Edges * Phenomenon Edges

Drones are shoulder weapons for Skells in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Ciniculas or Xe-doms. The Arts Scaling is 100% per hit. Damage Done = (1 to 1.05) * (R-Atk * 100% + (Weapon Attack * 1 plus/minus stability) ) * Additive Multipliers * (1 - Target Beam Resistance) * 28 hits
E-Bubbles are shoulder weapons for Skells in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Qmoevas bosses or by destroying Qmoevas' weapon appendages.
Dull Stones are common materials in . They can be obtained only from Glory Slobos or Gloria Slobos on Valak Mountain. Dull Stones are not otherwise available.

Drivers (Japanese: , Doraibā) are characters in and . They are linked to Blades, special lifeforms they create and summon by touching a Core Crystal. Blades endow their Driver with power and a weapon. By collecting and attaching different Blades to the playable Drivers, the player chooses and selects Blades companions and the kind of role desired given to each Driver. Notably, Nopon have very little aptitude to become Drivers, and as such Nopon Drivers are very, very rare, with only a few examples being known.

Dynamo Turbines are Mechanical collectibles in . They can be found by Salvaging at the Cliffs of Morytha. They can be used to fill the charging device during the quest Powered-Up Poppi. Each Dynamo Turbine will fill the gauge by 1 point.
Eclipse Serpronds (Japanese: , Ekuripusu Rodon) are enemies in . They are members of the Serprond family, and can be found at level 44-46 at the Merto Island in the Leftherian Archipelago.

Dream of Rice is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Kingdom of Uraya by speaking to Tilde in the Gwenith Paddies, when the nation has at least 4 stars in Development Level. The time required to complete this mission is 2 hours, but it can be reduced down to 30 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Ancient Wisdom", "Agronomy" and "Botany" Field Skills.

Dringworm Hunting is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Leftherian Archipelago by talking to Vargon in the Fonsett Residential Area, when the nation has at least 4 stars in Development Level. The time required to complete this mission is 100 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 25 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Entomology", "Focus" and "Electric Mastery" Field Skills.
Echo Edge (Japanese: ) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Mòrag's arts when using a Monado. This art recycles Mòrag's Mountain Crusher.
Duplicity is a quest in . It can be received from Yrrith in the Aletta Harbor in the Kingdom of Torna.
The Drahaga Store is a shop in . It is located at Centrilo Parade in the City.
Elder Attack Gems are an unused Key Item in . They would have unlocked the ability to craft certain gems, but as all gems can be crafted immediately, they are not used in-game.
Elder Defense Gems are an unused Key Item in . They would have unlocked the ability to craft certain gems, but as all gems can be crafted immediately, they are not used in-game.
Elder Healing Gems are an unused Key Item in . They would have unlocked the ability to craft certain gems, but as all gems can be crafted immediately, they are not used in-game.
Elder Assorted Gems are an unused Key Item in . They would have unlocked the ability to craft certain gems, but as all gems can be crafted immediately, they are not used in-game.

Eggs (Japanese: , Eggu) are a family of enemies in . Like Pods or Nests, Eggs hold other enemies, which emerge when the egg either hatches or is destroyed. In and , they hold small Parisax, in , they hold Aspars, Rhoguls, Taos or Vollgulls.
Dragon God Alcar (Japanese: , Shinryū Arukatorazu) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Draigul family, and can be found at level 46 in the Raxeal Lavaflow on the Black Mountains.
Draigul Thaumahorns are items in . They can be dropped by Draiguls in Black Mountains.
Dragoon Tirkins are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Tirkin family, and can be found at level 42 at the Town of Banerro Ruins on the Black Mountains.
Egels (Japanese: , Ēguru) are a type of flying enemy in the . They resemble gargoyles.

Emerald Snows (Japanese: , Emerarudo Sunou) are collectables in . They can be found on Valak Mountain. According to their description, they are green snow made of wind-scattered leaves accumulated over time.

Entma Kings (Japanese: , Entoma Kingu) are minor enemies in . They are members of the Antol family, and can be found on Valak Mountain at level 45 - 47 in the Chilkin Lair south of Bagnar Snowfield, and also northwest of the Mechonis Wound. They drop Soya Paste Shells, two of which are needed for the quest Cook-Off Showdown!.

Ent Antols (Japanese: , Ento Antoru) are minor enemies in . They are members of the Antol family, and can be found inside the Chilkin Lair and west of Mechonis Wound at Valak Mountain. They are one group of monsters in Chilkins and Antols, where five of them must be defeated. They are the only enemies that drop Antol Fire Pouches, two of which are needed for The Freezing Nopon.

The Empty Throne (Japanese: , Kūi no Gyokuza) is a landmark in . It is located on the third floor of Prison Island. It overlooks the entire Arena. A Heart-to-Heart - "Journey's End" - is located here.

Emeraude Nebulae (Japanese: , Emurōdo Nebura) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are members of the Nebula family, and can be found at level 40 near the High Entia Transporter on the first visit to Prison Island. It can drop the Squall Elements needed for Colony 6 Reconstruction.
Eques Skyrays (Japanese: , Ekuesu An'noun) are enemies in . They are members of the Laia family, and can be found at level 41 near the High Entia Transporter on the first visit to Prison Island.

Elvira, the Talondrake (Japanese: , Kagiga-ryū Erivīra) is a Tyrant in . It is a member of the Colubrim family. It can be found at level 90 sleeping in the entrance to the Drop Shaft in Primordia during the day, or flying around Talon Rock Summit at night.

The Enhanced Defense Seidr (Japanese: , Taisei Kyōka-gata Basugia) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a Seidr Ganglion machine. It can be found at level 59 in the sky above Anvil Sandplain in Sylvalum. It flies within the arms of Luxaar's Xern, making it impossible to fight without gaining the attention of the much more powerful ship.

Enemies are the AI-controlled opponents faced by the party in and . Enemies can be found all over Bionis and Mechonis, alone or in groups, and can be fought by the party to gain experience or progress in the story. When enemies are defeated, the party gains EXP, AP, and SP. Regular enemies are usually members of a species, reflected in the second part of their names (for example, Knuckle Bunnits are members of the Bunnit family). Exceptions to this rule are the more powerful Unique Monsters that all have unique names (for example, the Verdant Bluchal), various quest exclusive and story exclusive enemies, and bosses. Enemies, like playable characters, have levels and use arts in battle. More

Esko Krabbles (Japanese: , Esukepu Kuraibu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles 2. They are level 2 members of the Krabble family, and can appear when Salvaging in Argentum at the Salvage Deck, Maelstrom, or Goldmouth Flight Deck.

This page lists all the quests available in the Empire of Mor Ardain. The list may be viewed in the order they become available or the order they appear in the Quest Log. Some quests require certain Blades to be acquired or leveled up. Due to the nature of unlocking Blades, it may be difficult to do all of these quests as soon as the chapter requirement is met. If a quest requires a specific Blade, it will be noted. Terms and abbreviations are explained in the legend at the bottom of the page. |-|Availability Order= This table is divided into sections based on the point in the story at which they become available (if other prerequisites are met). When using a Blade equipped with this core in a Chain Attack, it makes their attacks completely destroy an elemental orb of their opposite element, instead of inflicting 2 hits worth of damage. The Skill RAM/Upgrade variants can be used to customize Poppi α, Poppi QT and Poppi QTπ as an Aux Core equivalent. __TOC__

Energy Investigation is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Leftherian Archipelago, and is unlocked automatically when the nation reaches 5 stars in Development Level. The time required to complete this mission is 2 hours, but it can be reduced down to 30 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Mastery of Thunder", "Light Mastery" and "Production Mastery" Field Skills.

Elpys Investigation is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Leftherian Archipelago, and is unlocked automatically when Garfont Mercenaries reaches Merc Level 5 and the nation reaches 5 stars in Development Level. It will only become available after gaining access to the Spirit Crucible Elpys. The time required to complete this mission is 2 hours, but it can be reduced down to 30 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Ice Mastery", "Dark Mastery" and "Info Collector" Field Skills.

Ether Furnace Checks is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Kingdom of Tantal from Seekhelos at the Capital Approach, when the nation has at least 1 star in Development Level. The time required to complete this mission is 30 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 7 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Industry Mastery", "Focus" and "Extra-Ancient Wisdom" Field Skills.

Elemental Awakening is a Status in and . It can only be used by Bosses in Challenge Battle Mode, and some enemies in , mainly Unique Monsters. It is activated when the enemy gains an elemental orb - through finishing a Blade Combo, or through placing one with the assistance of a common blade with the Orb Master skill, or through using a Special (in ). Elemental Awakening has a set chance to trigger depending on whether the enemy is Enraged or not. When active, the enemy deals more damage, recharges Arts faster, and makes Blade Combos wear off much faster. The strength of each effect varies between each of the different Awakening tiers. The status can be removed by using a Chain Attack to bur

The Erythia Relay Base (Japanese: , Erutia Chūkei Kichi) is a Location in , located on Thurbin Island in Erythia Sea. It is an Agnian base. The Front Gate Key is needed to open the front gate of the base.

Emerald Font (Japanese: , Suigyoku Hikari no Izumi) is a Landmark in . It is located in Rebellion Cave in Erythia Sea of the Cadensia Region. The party's Ouroboros powers are restricted here, which prevents Interlinking.
Erythia Sashimi Plates are Meal items in . They can be purchased from the Station Breakroom. Purchasing it for the first time unlocks the Highly-Piley Ocean's Bounty recipe for Manana's Menu.

Escape - Going Through Clouds - is a track from , composed by Yasunori Mitsuda. It is track eighteen of disc five from the Xenoblade 2 Original Soundtrack, and track eighteen of disc ten from the Xenoblade Original Soundtrack Trinity Box. It uses a motif from Elysium, in the Blue Sky. This track plays during the ending when the party escapes from the World Tree as it is destroyed, and sees the uncovered Land of Morytha while on Azurda's back.
Ether Plums (Japanese: , Ēderu Puramu) are collectables in . They can be found on Valak Mountain. According to their description, they are satisfyingly sweet plums that are popular with the ladies.
F Power Boosters are Mechonis boosters in Xenoblade Chronicles.
F Power Goggles (Japanese: , F Pawā Gōguru) are Mechonis goggles in Xenoblade Chronicles.
Ether III Goggles (Japanese: , Ēteru III Gōguru) are Mechonis goggles in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are built with the power of Egil's bodyguards.

Exposure Wolfol (Japanese: , Rokō no Woreforu) is a Unique Monster in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is a member of the Lexos family, and can be found at level 97 in the Lava Cave in Valak Mountain, after retrieving the Magma Rock. It takes the place of Conflagrant Raxeal once its related quest The Magma Rock is completed. It can drop a Silver Lexos Heart, two of which are needed for I Want to be a Homs!.
Ether III Frames are Mechonis frames in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are built with the power of Egil's bodyguards.

The Ether Gear Store (Japanese: , Ēteru Gia Hozonko) is a location in . It is located in Mechonis Field. Many collectables, and a Memory 925 Piece for The History of Mechonis can be found here. There are also two Ether Crystal deposits behind the enemies containing Muscle Up IV and Earth Cloak IV, Strength Up IV and Slow Resist IV respectively.

The Face Maintenance Bay (Japanese: , Kishin Feisu Seibijō) is a location in . It is located on the third floor of the Central Factory. An Ether Crystal deposit containing Slow Resist IV and Aggro Up IV crystals can be found here, although it is initially inaccessible due to a barrier. There is another deposit containing Daze Up IV and Daze Tension IV just outside of the Face Maintenance Bay, down the southern ramp towards Magestic Mordred. The Regeneration Control is located within the the Face Maintenance Bay, up a ramp towards the south end of the bay.
Evellos (Japanese: , Sutorutto) are bird-like enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X that walk on two legs and do not fly.

FN Site 110 is a Miranium Deposit in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in Primordia, on top of Talon Rock Summit. It is only accessible by flight, and a Data Probe must be planted here to complete the Affinity Mission A Girl's Wings.

FN Site 118 is a Miranium Deposit in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in Primordia. The Probe site is located inside the cave of a mountain on the south side of the area. The location beam from the site is not visible when scouting the area from the air. It can be reached from the lake just below it, by swimming to the very southern most side of the zone, and by heading up the zigzagged path leading up into the cave. There are no enemies here.
FN Site 319 is a Miranium Deposit in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in Oblivia, on an island off the South Coast.
FN Site 320 is a Miranium Deposit in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in Oblivia, on the Floating Reef, which can only be reached by flight.
FN Site 322 is a Miranium Deposit in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in Oblivia, below and south of Jair Fortress, at the easternmost point of land on the Miran continents.

FN Site 413 is a Miranium Deposit in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in Sylvalum, on the west side of the North Ciel Sandsea. The Scenic Viewpoint Xanadu Overlook can be found at the peak of the mountain southwest of the site, and the Tyrant Giraffin, the Old Hand is in the valley nearby.

FN Site 414 is a Miranium Deposit in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in Sylvalum, under the Noctilucent Sphere. The Unexplored Territory Quay Hollows can be found directly south of the site on the south side of the wall on a small peninsula sticking out over the ocean.

FN Site 510 is a Miranium Deposit in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located on the Forgotten Mining Frigates in Cauldros; the northernmost point of land in all five Miran continents. There are no enemies here.
FN Site 516 is a Miranium Deposit in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in Cauldros, on a small island to the far east.

The Experimental Flight Shrad (Japanese: , Hikō Shiken-gata Zuttā) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a Shrad Ganglion machine. It can be found at level 48 on a walkway north of the Capital Wreckage in Cauldros. It slowly hovers down upon spawning.

The FILE-M0101SS is a Schematic in Xenoblade Chronicles X. This item is dropped by Milsaadi Savages found in Cauldros. This schematic can be used to craft a Six Stars Longsword called Masterstroke Glaive at the AM Terminal.

The FILE-USP0460ME is a Schematic in Xenoblade Chronicles X. This item is from White Whale Debris on the island guarded by Sven, the Sturdy in NLA Waters. It requires Field-Skill Mechanical Level 5. This schematic can be used to craft a level 50 Skell Back Superweapon called Trident-Anchor at the AM Terminal.

The FILE-M0203SS is a Schematic in Xenoblade Chronicles X. This item is dropped by Milsaadi Savages found in Cauldros. This schematic can be used to craft Six Stars Dual Swords called Masterstroke Edges II at the AM Terminal.

The FILE-M0204SS is a Schematic in Xenoblade Chronicles X. This item is dropped by Milsaadi Champions in Sylvalum's Cavernous Abyss. This schematic can be used to craft Six Stars Dual Swords called Masterstroke Edges at the AM Terminal.

The FILE-M0601SS is a Schematic in Xenoblade Chronicles X. This item is dropped by Milsaadi Champions in Sylvalum's Cavernous Abyss. This schematic can be used to craft a Six Stars Photon Saber called Masterstroke Lightblade at the AM Terminal.

The FILE-M0102SS is a Schematic in Xenoblade Chronicles X. This item is dropped by Milsaadi Assassins, Milsaadi Heralds, and Milsaadi Protobattlers. This schematic can be used to craft a Six Stars Longsword called Masterstroke Glaive II at the AM Terminal.
The FILE-M0503SS is a Schematic in Xenoblade Chronicles X. This item is dropped by an enemy. This schematic can be used to craft a Six Stars Javelin called Masterstroke Lance at the AM Terminal.

The FILE-R0102SS is a Schematic in Xenoblade Chronicles X. This item is dropped by Marnuck Convergers. This schematic can be used to craft a Six Stars Assault Rifle called Masterstroke Raidrifle at the AM Terminal.

The FILE-R0205SS is a Schematic in Xenoblade Chronicles X. This item is dropped by Marnuck Dynamo. This schematic can be used to craft Six Stars Dual Guns called Masterstroke Sidearm at the AM Terminal.

The FILE-R0504SS is a Schematic in Xenoblade Chronicles X. This item is dropped by Marnuck Convergers. This schematic can be used to craft a Six Stars Sniper Rifle called Masterstroke Deadsight II at the AM Terminal.

The FILE-M0602SS is a Schematic in Xenoblade Chronicles X. This item is dropped by Milsaadi Champions in Sylvalum's Cavernous Abyss. This schematic can be used to craft a Six Stars Photon Saber called Masterstroke Lightblade II at the AM Terminal.

Exiting Tantal is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Kingdom of Tantal, and is unlocked automatically when the nation reaches 1 star in Development Level. The time required to complete this mission is 40 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 10 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Expeditionist" and "Nopon Wisdom" Field Skills.

Everyone Loves Floren is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Kingdom of Uraya by completing the mission Bait Battle. The time required to complete this mission is 20 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 5 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Fortitude", "Girls' Talk" and "Superstrength" Field Skills.

Everdark Erg (Japanese: , Tokoyami no Eruku) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Quadwing family and can be found at level 36 in the Lasaria Region of the Kingdom of Torna, flying around Lasaria Woodland.

The Ether Furnace Controls are a switch in . They are located in a small room southeast of the Great Hall in Alcamoth and are accessible after the events at Mechonis Core. They reactivate the transporters of Alcamoth. They must be repaired then activated during Broken Ether Furnace 2. After fixing them, the Primordial Telethia appears in front of the room and must be defeated. Restoring power to Alcamoth's transporters makes possible to reach Whitewing Palace and Revelation Hall to complete Vidian Rescue Mission and A Merciful End respectively.
F Sun Visors are Mechonis goggles in . They can be obtained as rewards after clearing the Time Attack challenge Sparks Fly, You Die. They can only be worn by Fiora.
F Water Frames are Mechonis frame in . They can be obtained as rewards after clearing the Time Attack challenge Sparks Fly, You Die. They can only be worn by Fiora.
F Water Arms are Mechonis arms in . They can be obtained as rewards after clearing the Time Attack challenge Sparks Fly, You Die. They can only be worn by Fiora.
The Expedition Elevator (Japanese: , Sōsakutai no Shōkōki, Search Party Elevator) is a location in , located on the Black Mountains.
Exalted Ories Briskets are items in . They can be dropped by Mant Ories in Black Mountains.

Eye of Shining Justice is a Track in , composed by ACE. It is track twelve of disc three from the Xenoblade 2 Original Soundtrack, and track twelve of disc eight from the Xenoblade Original Soundtrack Trinity Box. This song plays during the following moments: * When Zeke and Pandoria appear before the party in Uraya and Mor Ardain. * When the Tirkin King wants both Finch and Omulette as his Kountesses during Birds of a Feather. * When Mythra and Kora are forced to dance in front of the rest of the party as punishment at the end of Girl Power-Off. * When Sheba realizes that she was swindled out of one million G at the start of Fool's Gold.

Fire Apples (Japanese: , Faiappuru) are collectables in . They can be found on Valak Mountain and in Colony 6. According to their description, they look like ordinary apples but one bite and the person who eats them will be spouting flames.

Although whether the Final Marcus should be considered a Superboss has been the subject of debate, for the purposes of this Wiki he has been included in the list. Final Marcus (Japanese: , Shūsei no Mākusu) is one of the five Superbosses in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is a Unique Monster and a Slobos found at level 100 the Three Sage Summit on Valak Mountain at night (clear or snowing). Unlike the other superbosses, it is immediately present in the area rather than appearing after events later in the game. There are two Gloria Slobos by his spawn location, although both they and Final Marcus can be lured away individually to a safer place for battle. The nearby Slobos will not join the battle u
Fatal Belladonnas (Japanese: , Deranata) are collectables in . They can be found on Valak Mountain. According to their description, they look like fairies at play and they make everybody smile.

Feris Aged Ales are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be obtained from Noto Feris in Valak Mountain. Feris Aged Ales are also available via trade. According to their description, they are brewed slowly over 1000 years, most of which has evaporated away. One Feris Aged Ale is needed for The Freezing Nopon.

Femuny Wisps (Japanese: , Femunī Ranpusu) are enemies in . They are members of the Wisp family. They can be found flying around the Forgotten Cave at level 90. They drop the Wisp Sun Bead, which is required for the quest Replica Monado 3. The easiest way to reach them is to fast travel to the Heavenly Window, turn around, and jump down the first hole seen.

Fiendish Auburn (Japanese: , Onio no Ōbān) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Balgas family, and can be found at level 78 on Gravina Bridge in Prison Island. It appears after killing the three Babel Deinos and the three Babeli Bargs. It is accompanied by two Caura Balgas.
Fiume Nebulae (Japanese: , Fiūme Nebura) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are members of the Nebula family, and can be found at level 74 on Prison Island in the Central Hall.
Feltl Eks (Japanese: , Ferutoru Ekusu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are members of the Eks family, and can be found at night at level 98 on Bionis' Right Elbow on Valak Mountain.

First Sight of Snow (Japanese: , Miwatasukagiri no Yukigeshiki) is a Heart-to-Heart in . It is located at the War God Statue in La Luz Church on Valak Mountain, between Fiora and Reyn at purple affinity. It can only be viewed at night.

Faded Adseculas (Japanese: , Fēdo Apisu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Adsecula family, and can be found at level 33-35 on the winding oceanside trail by North Coast in Oblivia. Ten of them must be defeated during The Duel (Part I).

Fal-swos (Japanese: , Gi-suo) are machine enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are mysterious Miran flying drones that resemble jet fighters, with large glowing orbs in the wings. Fal-swos are not affected by adverse weather.
The Far Isle of Tzu'o (Japanese: , Tsu O Zettō) is an area in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is an island off the north coast of Cauldros, and the location of FN Site 501 and a mechanical Treasure Box.

Faith Series is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a Factory 1.21 Raygun. It is obtained as a reward for completing the Normal Mission Professorial, alongside the Honor, Rapture and Multi Series. The Faith weapons available in-game are: * Storm Faith * Soldier Faith * Warrior Faith * Ophidian Faith * Destroyer Faith * Striker Faith * Delta Faith * Cosmic Faith * Nebulan Faith
Filthy Wings are items in . They are common items dropped by low-level flying enemies, and are also available through trade.

Falala (Japanese: , Farara) is an NPC in . Falala is a Nopon who can be found at Rumbletum Canteen in the Argentum Trade Guild. She is the mother of Solala. After completing Fame and Family, she opens a shop called Falala, Popstar.

Fizz Juices are Drink Pouch items in . They can be purchased from 12 Brothersisterpon in the Argentum Trade Guild. They are one of the favorite Pouch items of Poppi α. Four need to be used to unlock Poppi α's Level 3 "Superstrength" Field Skill. Three Fizz Juice can be received for free if the Expansion Pass has been bought.

Fame and Family is a quest in . It can be received from Falala at the Rumbletum Canteen in the Argentum Trade Guild. She asks the party to make her a potion called "Serenade" in order to help her singing career. After this quest is completed the item Spicy Stralu can be purchased from Falala, Popstar.

Farming Tech is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Gormott Province, and is unlocked automatically when the nation reaches 5 stars in Development Level. It will only become available after visiting the Kingdom of Tantal for the first time. The time required to complete this mission is 2 hours, but it can be reduced down to 30 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Production Mastery", "Botany" and "Agronomy" Field Skills. It rewards store contracts that unlock the following wares: * Mustard Kordeth in Gryff Butchers * Sparkly Snow Perfume in Cosmetipolitan * Snowflake Scarf in Neuromin Textiles

Fad Foods is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Kingdom of Uraya, and is unlocked automatically when the nation reaches 1 star in Development Level. The time required to complete this mission is 40 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 10 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Patissier", "Production Mastery" and "Info Collector" Field Skills. It rewards store contracts that unlock the following wares: * Fizzy Lassi in Vargel Tavern * Glitterspud Puran in Brad Flatforms * Steamed Bluegill in Ikthus Fishmongers
Fayl Symbols (Japanese: , Feiru Shinboru) are enemies in . They are Standards, and can be found at level 34-36 at the Old City of Teddim in the Empire of Mor Ardain.

Falala, Popstar is a shop in . It is run by Falala and can be found at Rumbletum Canteen in the Argentum Trade Guild. It is specialized in Meats. This shop is unlocked ater completing the quest Fame and Family.

Field Pests is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Leftherian Archipelago by talking to Lynnaeon in the garden near Corinne's House, when the nation has at least 1 star in Development Level. The time required to complete this mission is 40 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 10 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Entomology" and "Agronomy" Field Skills.

Fiercest Faction is a Challenge Battle in . It can be received from the Nopon Archsage in the Land of Challenge, available as downloadable content from the Challenge Battle Mode Pack of the Expansion Pass. This challenge must be completed in order to unlock Fiora's level 4 Power Smash Blade Special. This challenge takes place in the Hallowed Godswood Shrine at the Cliffs of Morytha.
Farview Cape (Japanese: , Sangaikei no Misaki) is a Location in . It is located in Erythia Sea in the Cadensia Region. After Chapter 5, the City can be accessed from here.

Fixifixi is an NPC in . He is Valdi's masterpon and one of the Seven Legendary Nopon throughout Aionios who wield an Ultimate Hammer. Fixifixi can be found in the locked cell in Li Garte Prison Camp, which opens after completing In Search of a Home. In order to get him to go to the City during Uniting the Seven Nopon the party must speak to him with Valdi in the party.

In , the legendary variant can be obtained from a Relic in the Black Mountains, north of the Ancient Rooftop Camp. The common and rare variants can be dropped by Fogdweller Abaasy.

Fine Attack Gems are an unused Key Item in . They would have unlocked the ability to craft certain gems, but as all gems can be crafted immediately, they are not used in-game.
Fine Defense Gems are an unused Key Item in . They would have unlocked the ability to craft certain gems, but as all gems can be crafted immediately, they are not used in-game.
Fine Healing Gems are an unused Key Item in . They would have unlocked the ability to craft certain gems, but as all gems can be crafted immediately, they are not used in-game.
Fine Assorted Gems are an unused Key Item in . They would have unlocked the ability to craft certain gems, but as all gems can be crafted immediately, they are not used in-game.

The Ferronis Crater (Japanese: , Tetsukyoshin no Kurētā) is a Landmark in , located below the Diablada Cliffs on the Aurora Shelf. It is a crater that formed due to the impact caused by W's fused Ferronis, the Agnian and Kevesi Ferronises, falling to the ground after being destroyed. The remains of both Ferronis are scattered across the crater. It becomes accessible via an Ether Lift. There is an Affinity Scene located here.

Finley is an NPC in . She is a City Survivor who is initally found in the Lakeside Grotto in Yesterdale. After being rescued, she moves to Colony 9 to be with her older brother, Axel. Finley's Community is gained when talking to her after completing The Junior Workforce.

The Floppy Crest is a common material item in Xenoblade Chronicles. It can be obtained from two Flying Enemies in Makna Forest or through trade in Frontier Village. According to their description, they are invigorating crests that look a little worse for wear.

Flier Straws are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be obtained from Fliers on Bionis' Leg and Kneecap Hill. Flier Straws can also be traded for with Anna, but only when she is in the Refugee Camp and before the refugees move back to Colony 6. According to their description, they are convoluted spiral straws that require tremendous lung power to use. Seven are needed for A Gutsy Trader.

Fortune Mallows (Japanese: , Raburī Fukkī, Lovely Hooky) are collectables in . They can be found on Valak Mountain. According to their description, they are popular with women and children while some find them too beautiful to behold.

The Fountain of Hope (Japanese: 希望の噴水, Kibō no Funsui) is a landmark in . It is a fountain in the imperial city of Alcamoth. It is one of the two fountains on the ground floor, the other being the Fountain of Eternity. These two fountains are located in the middle of the north and south half of the floor. The Fountain of Hope is the southern fountain.

The Fountain of Eternity (Japanese: 永遠の噴水, Eien no Funsui) is a landmark in . It is a fountain in the imperial city of Alcamoth. It is one of the two fountains on the ground floor, the other being the Fountain of Hope. These two fountains are located in the middle of the north and south half of the floor. The Fountain of Eternity is the northern fountain.
Fliers (Japanese: , Furaia) are an enemy family in the . They are flying insects which look similar to butterflies. All fliers have the same appearance.

Flabbergasted Jerome (Japanese: , Hekireki no Jirōne) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Nebula family, and can be found at level 38 on the island below Hovering Reef 5 on Eryth Sea, which can be reached by dropping through the hole in the middle of the reef. It takes the appearance of a Buono Nebula. It is also the quest monster for Challenge given at Syrath Lighthouse on Eryth Sea.

Fork Chilkins (Japanese: , Hoku Chirukin) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are members of the Chilkin family, and can be found at level 44 on Valak Mountain in the Antol Den. They only appear after hatching from Bonterra Pods. They can drop the Aged Chilkin Hairs needed for A Token of Friendship.

The Freight Elevator (Japanese: , Hanshutsu-yō Erebētā) is a location in . It is located at Colony 6. It is an elevator that descends into the Central Pit of the Ether Mine, located at the north end of Freight Road. However, when the party is escaping the mine, they fight with Xord, who destroys the entire Central Pit of the mine, rendering this elevator useless. There is an Ether Planter here. During Defend Colony 6 - Elite an M71 Fire Support appears near the ether planter and must be defeated to complete the quest. A Heart-to-Heart - "Renewed Determination" - is located here.

Flood Elements are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can only be dropped by Fiume Nebulae on Prison Island and are not available for trade. According to their description, they are water elements that increase the volume of water.

Formula is a Light Type Skell unit in . Formula is one of the Skells of BLADE produced in New Los Angeles. The Formula corresponds to the standard and most affordable model for production deployment. Its vehicle form is a sort of futuristic armed motorcycle. The level 60 upgrade of this frame is the Formula Zero. During A Girl's Wings, the test Skell piloted by Cross is an AS0115 Formula XT, a level 15 version of the Formula. The equipped weapons and armor cannot be changed but can be removed, kept in inventory and used after the mission (Though this was fixed in the Definitive Edition). It is registered to Cross for the duration of the test flight. It is removed at the end of the mission, l
Flight Time is a Heart-to-Heart in . It is located inside the Outfitters Test Hangar in the Industrial District of New Los Angeles, between Lin and Cross at night.
The Floatstone Shard is an Important Item in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It must be acquired at a floating island near Talon Rock Summit in Primordia for Mia Grows Up.

Flying Boulders is a Squad Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is part of BLADE Mission No.7, and is unlocked when the Squad has completed the Squad Task of hunting ten Simius. It can be accepted at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.

Free Electricity is a Squad Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is part of BLADE Mission No.11, and is unlocked when the Squad has completed the Squad Task of hunting four Kringe, the Hunting Arrows. It can be accepted at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.

Flying Fish Fight is a Squad Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is part of BLADE Mission No.11, and is unlocked when the Squad has completed the Squad Task of hunting twenty Evellos. It can be accepted at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.

Fonsett Village (Japanese: , Iyasaki Mura), also known as Hero's Rest, is a location in . It is a village in the Leftherian Archipelago, located on Fonsett Island, and is one of the main settlements of the Leftherians. Fonsett was founded by Addam, and is the place were Rex grew up.
Fonsett Arch (Japanese: , Iyasaki-mura Kyōmon) is a Landmark in . It is located on Fonsett Island in the Leftherian Archipelago. It serves as the entrance into Fonsett Village.
The Fonsett Residential Area (Japanese: , Iyasaki-mura Kyojūku) is a location in . It is located on Fonsett Island in the Leftherian Archipelago, and is where Rex spent his childhood.

Forest Fire Prevention (Japanese: , Yamakaji wo Fusege!) is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Gormott Province, and is unlocked automatically when Garfont Mercenaries reaches Merc Level 2 and the nation reaches 3 stars in Development Level. The time required to complete this mission is 1 hour, but it can be reduced down to 15 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Water Mastery", "Passionate Soul" and "Forestry" Field Skills.

Flotsam Inspection is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Kingdom of Uraya by talking to Cabott, who stands watch by the Garfont Rear Gate, when the nation has at least 1 star in Development Level. The time required to complete this mission is 30 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 7 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Focus", "Mineralogy" and "Keen Eye" Field Skills.
Fort Ignas (Japanese: , Fōto Igūna) are enemies in . They are members of the Igna family, and can be found at level 29-34 at the Old City of Teddim in the Empire of Mor Ardain.
Flash Scouts (Japanese: , Furasshu Sukauto) are enemies in . They are members of the Igna family, and can be found at level 31-33 at the Old City of Teddim in the Empire of Mor Ardain.

Fort Rescue is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Kingdom of Uraya by talking to the Nopon Popono on a balcony in Torika Alley, when the nation has at least 4 stars in Development Level. The balcony can be reached by using a nearby Airflow, which requires "Wind Mastery" Lv.3 and "Leaping" Lv.1 to activate. The time required to complete this mission is 2 hours, but it can be reduced down to 30 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Fortitude", "Fleet of Foot" and "Ice Mastery" Field Skills.

Flowing Shadow (Japanese: ) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Mòrag's arts when using Brilliant Twinblades. It can be obtained upon New Game Plus, after finishing the game and installing Patch (Ver.1.3.0). This art recycles Mòrag's Twin Moonblade.

The Formide Shopping Ward (Japanese: , Forumīdo Shōtengai) is a location in . It is located in the southwestern corner of Auresco, and serves as the commercial center for the city. Spefan Inn is located here, as are a number of shops and NPCs.

|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Florid Armrings are Accessories in and . The common variant can be purchased from the Colony Mu Commissary and Island Caravan. The legendary variant can be purchased from the Prize X-change Blue or obtained from Farseer Pirtett. In , the legendary variant can be obtained from Thunderfish Duna-Roa.

Flyswatter Kamado (Japanese: , Chigai no Kamodo) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Antol family, and can be found at level 77 on Daedal Isle in Erythia Sea. The Spider Web Art can be earned for the Soulhacker class by defeating it.
The Founders' Tale, Latest Vol. is a Key Item in . It is a book written by Leeanne about the City's Founders, and it is sold by Wellwell at Wellwell's Emporium for 700 G during Writer's Block.
The Front Gate Key is a Key Item in . It can be found on Thurbin Island. It is used to open the front gate of the Erythia Relay Base.
Force of Nature (Japanese: , Neichāfōsu) is a Battle Art in . It is a variant of Staying Power that can only be used by Juniper.

Fogstalker Naiara (Japanese: , Rōmu no Ajirite) is a Unique Monster in . It is a Fogbeast Feris that can be found at level 45 in the area before Rhogett Causeway in Vermilion Woods after reaching the Black Mountains. It opens the battle with the Fast Recharge buff applied.
Foghewn Augustus (Japanese: , Muzō no Augusu) is a Unique Monster in . It is a Fogbeast Egel that can be found at level 48 at Travalga Bridge on the Black Mountains.

Fog-called Beasts are Normal Minor Enemies in . They are Fogbeasts summoned by Fog Rifts, and can be found between level 27 and 58 on the Aurora Shelf, The Ragmos Desolation or the Black Mountains. The Fog-called Beasts consist of various other Fogbeast enemies, but renamed as "Fog-called Beasts".

Galahad Fortress (Japanese: , Garahado yōsai; English dub: ) is an area in . It is the fortress that protects Mechonis from Homs. Kallian attacks the fortress after most of it was destroyed. After the Battle with Jade Face at the end of Chapter 13, Sword Valley and the fortress become inaccessible, and all of its Collectables will need to be acquired via trading. Even beyond completing the Collectopaedia, some of them are needed for the rebuilding of Colony 6.

Frost Glasses (Japanese: , Juhyō no Garasu, Treefrost Glass) are collectables in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be found on Valak Mountain or traded for. According to their description, Shulk was shivering when he named them and no one knows if they are ice or glass. Two are required for Broken Ether Furnace.

Funeral Gozra (Japanese: , Sōsō no Gozura) is a Unique Monster in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is a member of the Orluga family, and can be found at level 42 in the Hode Refuge in the Eryth Sea. It can be found in an alcove north of the main central section of the island. Defeating it is the objective of the Punish the Hodes quest. It can drop the Orluga Slacks needed for Material Quest 3.

Fuchsia Chilkin (Japanese: , Hokushia Chirukin) are enemies in . They are members of the Chilkin family, and can be found at level 43 near the Url Crevasse and the La Luz Church on Valak Mountain. They can drop the Aged Chilkin Hairs needed for A Token of Friendship.

Frozen Aries Meats are rare materials in . They can be dropped by Aries on Valak Mountain. Frozen Aries Meats are not otherwise available. According to their description, they are ethereal meats that are soft as snow and are so good that they make the consumer just want to float away. Two lots of Frozen Aries Meats are needed for the quest World's Strongest Flavour.

Gale Elements are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be obtained from Uragano Nebula in Prison Island. Gale Elements are not otherwise available. According to their description, they are wind elements that can conjure up a gale strong enough to cut skin.

Galactic Knight (known as Galaxy Knight in the Japanese version) is a Class featured in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is one of six final classes and can only be leveled up from Blast Fencer. This class provides bonuses to melee attack and ranged attack. Ga Jiarg's class is an Alternative Galactic Knight, called Galactic Knight+.

Gerrids (Japanese: , Girafa) are insectoid enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. Although the term seems to be derived from water striders (family Gerridae), they more closely resemble fleas. They can be found in Oblivia, Sylvalum, and Cauldros. Destroying a gerrid's back will release a toxic cloud, causing the gerrid to gain an ether-attribute ranged spike and Calm I buff.

G'nahan Villa (Japanese: , Gu-Nan Rikyū) is an area in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a large, inaccessable building located on northernmost mainland Cauldros. The building is a massive superstructure that cannot be entered, though its rooftop can be traversed by a Skell with a Flight Module. The Ganglion Antropolis is located in caves directly beneath the building. G'nahan Villa has a virtually identical exterior and dimensions as Kw'arah Villa, also in Cauldros.

The Frontline Surveillance Zig (Japanese: , Zensen Kanshiyō Jigu) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a Ganglion Zig machine. It can be found at level 74 on an island in Sylvalum Waters, northwest of FN Site 404.

Furious Simius (Japanese: , Fyūrī Shimiusu, Fury Simius) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Simius family, and can be found at level 34-36 on the islands in Primordia Waters.
Galaxial Jewels are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Saltats with shiny balls that emit sparkles.
Galdr D is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a black galdr variant wielding the creed revolver weapons. It can be obtained from Armed Destroyer Galdr in Cauldros.

Gemels Series is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts Grenada Galactic Group Dual Guns. It is obtained as a reward for completing the Fruits category of the Primordia Collectopedia. The Gemels weapons available in-game are: * Storm Gemels * Soldier Gemels * Warrior Gemels * Ophidian Gemels * Destroyer Gemels * Striker Gemels * Delta Gemels * Cosmic Gemels * Nebulan Gemels

Fwooshers Series is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts Nopon Commerce Guild Psycho Launchers. It is obtained as a reward for completing the Normal Mission Unsatisfied Customer. The Fwooshers weapons available in-game are: * Storm Fwooshers * Soldier Fwooshers * Warrior Fwooshers * Ophidian Fwooshers * Destroyer Fwooshers * Striker Fwooshers * Delta Fwooshers * Original Fwooshers * Cosmic Fwooshers * Nebulan Fwooshers
G-Revolvers are shoulder weapons for Skells in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from MG062: Megisia or by destroying Galdrs' weapon appendages.

Galea (Japanese: , Garatea, lit. Galatea) is a character who appears in . She was a co-worker of the scientist Klaus on Rhadamanthus, one of the Orbit Stations. As Klaus's co-worker, she is only viewed unnamed during a flashback cutscene in ; however, her reincarnation in this universe is called Meyneth.

Garanti Plain (Japanese: , Gorudoa Daiheigen) is a location in . It is located on the Upper Level - Right of the Gormott Province. It is a large open area connected to Lascham Island, Restful Waters, Waytree and Lyta Oasis. Low level enemies exist across the plain, alongside several Unique Monsters.
The Gates of Ulcaria (Japanese: , Urukaria Seimon) are a landmark in . They are located on the Upper Level of the Kingdom of Tantal, between Lumos Pillar and the Pillar City Ruins.
Full Moon Eyeliners are Cosmetic Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Cleo's Cosmetics in Goldmouth in the Argentum Trade Guild.

Genbu-Weave Clothes are Textile Pouch items in . They can be purchased at the Boldarde Textiles shop, in the Residential Area of Theosoir in the Kingdom of Tantal. They are one of Poppi QT's favorite Pouch items. Three are needed during the quest Powered-Up Poppi.
Full-Moon Mirrors are Treasure items in . They can be obtained through Salvaging at the Dalnes Stone in Temperantia.

Garnia Camills (Japanese: , Ganāi Kamiru) are enemies in . They are members of the Camill family, and can be found at level 32-36 on Baldotas Isle and outside Fonsett Village on Fonsett Island in the Leftherian Archipelago. Four of them must be defeated to unlock Finch's level 3 Wake-Up Whirl and Ursula's level 3 Beary Helpful on their affinity charts.

Frozen Door is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Kingdom of Tantal, and is unlocked automatically when the nation reaches 1 star in Development Level. The time required to complete this mission is 40 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 10 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Industry Mastery", "Fire Mastery" and "Focus" Field Skills. It rewards store contracts that unlock the following wares: * Poached Fruit Samod in Platini Deli * Bagna Oyster Roll in Tatraty Fish * Smack-A-Nopon in Hobby Trappers

Gachagacha is an NPC in . He is a Nopon who can be found at the Goldmouth Flight Deck in the Argentum Trade Guild. He gives the DLC quest Hot Spring Bonanza upon installing the New Quests Pack 4 of the Expansion Pass.
Galaxy Charms are Charms in . They can be created by Lora at Campsites. The recipe is obtained as a reward for completing the quest A Rare Sense of Justice.

Gemini Strike (Japanese: , jemini sutoraiku) is a Talent Art in . It is the Talent Art of the Zephyr class. It is a powerful technique to evade enemy attacks while at the same time gathering the enemy's aim. With this move, the user can attract the attention of enemies and protect her friends at once.

Galaxy Swirls are Collectible items in . They can be found in the Cadensia Region. They can also be purchased from the Ascension Caravan, or produced from the Atoll Ferronis Hulk Fabricator or the Sandbar Ferronis Hulk Fabricator.
Gemcrafting 101 is an unused Key Item in . It would have unlocked the ability to craft certain gems, but as all gems can be crafted immediately, it is not used in-game.
Full Moon Drop (Japanese: , Furumūndoroppu) is a Battle Art in . It is one of Mio's Ouroboros arts.
Garlus Fossils are Fossil Collectibles in . They can be found on the Black Mountains. They are fossilized Garluses.

Gogol Horns (Japanese: , Gogōru no Jūōkaku) are rare materials in . They can be dropped by any Gogol except the Dogmatic Gogol, but are not available for trade. According to their description, a flute made from them has the power to tame monsters. Three each are needed for A Token of Friendship and the reconstruction of Colony 6. In Definitive Edition, they can be purchased in the Time Attack place from Nopon Archsage for 7,500 Noponstones.

Glorious Buer (Japanese: , Sōbi no Bueru) is a Unique Monster in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is a member of the Chilkin family, and can be found at level 45 south of the Sealed Tower on Valak Mountain on a plateau by the steep paths separating the Sealed Tower area from the snowfield to the south, approximately halfway between the Sealed Tower and La Luz Church. It can drop the Aged Chilkin Hairs needed for A Token of Friendship.
Girl Courgettes (Japanese: , Gāru Zukkīni) are collectables in . They can be found on Valak Mountain. According to their description, they are cute red courgettes that are sweet and succulent.

Gloria Slobos (Japanese: , Gurōria Sorobosu) are enemies in . They are members of the Slobos family, and can be found at level 99 at Three Sage Summit on Valak Mountain at nighttime. The Final Marcus, one of the Superbosses, can also be found there. They can drop the Yellow Slobos Rock needed for Replica Monado 5.

Gimran Egels (Japanese: , Gimaran Ēguru) are enemies in . They can be found at level 75 on Travalga Bridge in Prison Island. They sit motionless along the bridge and appear to be gargoyle-like decorations until they attack, or are attacked by, the party. They are the only types of Egel that appear in .
Gracile Nebulae (Japanese: , Gurachīre Nebura) are enemies in . They are members of the Nebula family, and can be found at level 76 on Prison Island in the Battle Arena.

Golden Eks Hearts are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be obtained from the Wandering Amon, as well as Setor and Feltl Eks on Valak Mountain. Golden Eks Hearts are also available for trade.

Gigawatt Elements are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be obtained from Bulganon Nebulae in Eryth Sea. Gigawatt Elements are not otherwise obtainable. According to their description, they are lightning elements that contain billions of watts of electricity.

Glimmering Scintimures (Japanese: , Gurimā Torizumo) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Scintimure family, and can be found at level 40 above the Lower Delusian Mountains in Sylvalum.

Glaive II Series is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a Six Stars Longsword. It is obtained as a reward for completing the Normal Mission The Duel (Part IV). The Glaive II weapons available in-game are: * Audacious Glaive II * Faithful Glaive II * Intrepid Glaive II * Masterstroke Glaive II * Pulverizing Glaive II * Steelbreaker Glaive II * Godbreaker Glaive II * Phenomenon Glaive II

Goldmouth (Japanese: , Gorutomunto) is an area in . It is the primary Titan of the Argentum Trade Guild, and looks like a flying whale. This Titan carries the mercantile nation's ship like an air balloon above the Cloud Sea.

The Goldmouth Flight Deck (Japanese: , Gorutomunto Hikōkanpan) is a Landmark in . It is located in Goldmouth of the Argentum Trade Guild. A salvage point can be found next to the crane at the very end of the deck.

Glitterspuds are Vegetable collectibles in . They can be found at the Argentum Trade Guild, in particular on the Goldmouth Flight Deck. In the , Glitterspuds can also be obtained by scanning an amiibo.

Gormott Secret Area (Japanese: , Gūra no Hikyō) is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Gormott Province, and is unlocked automatically when the nation reaches 3 stars in Development Level. The time required to complete this mission is 80 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 20 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Forestry" and "Ancient Wisdom" Field Skills.

Goods Transport is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Kingdom of Uraya, and is unlocked automatically when the nation reaches 1 star in Development Level. The time required to complete this mission is 1 hour, but it can be reduced down to 15 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Transport Mastery" and "Mental Arithmetic" Field Skills.

Gondola Inspection is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Empire of Mor Ardain by talking to Tarcah near Nharil Central Plaza, when the nation has at least 2 stars in Development Level. The time required to complete this mission is 50 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 12 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Focus", "Leaping" and "Industry Mastery" Field Skills.

Got 'Em is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Gormott Province after completing the mission Chase Is On. The time required to complete this mission is 20 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 5 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Earth Mastery", "Wind Mastery" and "Superstrength" Field Skills.

Glittering Stars is a Skill RAM/Upgrade in . It increases Tora's aggro passively by up to 30 every second. It is equivalent in effect to the Nopon Mask, Metal Nopon Mask, Gold Nopon Mask and Platinum Nopon Mask accessories, and can stack with them. It can be used to customize Poppi α, Poppi QT and Poppi QTπ as an Aux Core equivalent. __TOC__

Girl Power is a Heart-to-Heart in . It is located at Blossomshade Cliff in the Kingdom of Uraya. It features a conversation between Kora, Pandoria, Brighid, Pyra, Poppi α, and Kora's Driver. The first option increases Kora's Trust by 900, and the second option increases it by 1000.
Going Beyond Power (Japanese: , Chikara no Yukusaki) is a Hero Quest in , dedicated to Teach. The "Scree Walking" Traversal Skill is unlocked during this quest.

Goran Moglums are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Moglum family, and can be found at level 73-74 at the center of Daedal Isle in Erythia Sea. One is also fought at level 53 during the third wave of the Challenge Battle Ocean Day Parade.

Gotthard, the Ethereal (Japanese: , Mugen no Kakuryū Gottoharuto, Phantom Horn Dragon Gotthard) is a Superboss in . It is a Darbus Unique Monster that can be found at level 60 at the Sullied Temple of Abitalia on the Aurora Shelf after reaching the Black Mountains.

Gypsum Branches (Japanese: , Sekkouju) are collectables in . They can be found on Valak Mountain. According to their description, they are branches from ice trees and they send a beam of light into the sky at night, implying they are what the large icicles around the area are made of.

Green Cams (Japanese: , Gurīn Kamu) are collectables in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be found on Prison Island. According to their description, many scientists would enjoy thinking up ways to use them.
The Great Canyon (Japanese: , Daikeikoku) is a location in . It is located on the fourth floor of Prison Island.

The Great Hall (Japanese: , Ōhiroma) is a location in . It is located within the Imperial Palace at Alcamoth. It is the large hall entered directly after walking into the palace. Several nameless High Entia guards can be found here, as well as Galdo, Lar'shen, Galvin and Lecrough. It can be reached by skip travelling to the Imperial Palace and walking east into the Palace, and contains teleporters to the Imperial Villa and Whitewing Palace. If the party continues east, up the stairs, they will reach the Ascension Hall. Toward the back of the Great Hall is a mural depicting the battle between the Bionis and Mechonis. After the events of the Mechonis Core, it becomes inhabited by Telethia - el

The Great Glacier (Japanese: , Dai hyōgen chitai, lit. icefield zone) is a location in . It is located on Valak Mountain, east of Bionis' Wrist and northwest of Nofol Tower. Here, the party meets Face Nemesis for the second time and encounters Metal Face, who is revealed to be Mumkhar and attempts to steal the Monado. After the events of Mechonis Core, the Blizzard Belgazas appears where Mumkhar was fought.

The Great Battle Scar (Japanese: , Kodai Futagami Sensō no Kizuato, lit. Scar of the Ancient War of the Two Gods) is a Secret Area in . It is an enormous cut on the exterior of the Mechonis, forming a steep slope that passes through the 4F level down to 3F. There are several ledges along the slope which can only be reached by sliding down from a higher point on the slope. One of these ledges leads to the Machina Refuge. The slope is too steep to walk up normally, and an uncontrolled slide down the slope will cause the party to overshoot the ledges and hit bottom at a fatal velocity. However, running or jumping directly uphill while sliding can reduce the character's speed enough to stop on o

The Great Washington Isle (Japanese: , Gurēto Washinton-tō) is an Unexplored Territory in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located on the raised land of the island off the southeastern coast of Oblivia. A Skell is required to jump high enough to reach the location. As with all Unexplored Territories, its discovery yields an achievement ("On Great Washington Isle").

Greater Gemini Bridge (Japanese: , Daiichi no Sōji-bashi) is a landmark in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in Primordia, in the northwestern part of the continent. A lone Prone Vix Griffin stands guard at one edge of the bridge.

Guide Owl Galdr (Japanese: , Gaidoouru Garudora) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Galdr machines and can be found at level 36-37 near Lotus Keep Building Site in Noctilum, flying in the air.

HT665: Erio (Japanese: , HT665: Erio) is a NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. She is a Definian first seen in her true form on an island near the West Gate Plain in Primordia at the end of the Normal Mission Attack on Biahno Hills. At a later time, she can be found in the Central Industrial District of New Los Angeles. She is found later near Central Melville Street in the Commercial District.

Gremlin Stones are unique materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from the weak points of rock Falsaxums. They are components in all Extend Critical Power augments. One is required for The Jewelmonger.

Gularthian Everflames are unique materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Gularth. They drop most commonly from the weak points that are revealed after destroying the back appendage.

Grando II Series is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a Meredith & Co. Gatling Gun. It is obtained as a reward for completing the Normal Mission Cavern Crushers. The Grando II weapons available in-game are: * Storm Grando II * Soldier Grando II * Warrior Grando II * Ophidian Grando II * Destroyer Grando II * Striker Grando II * Delta Grando II * Cosmic Grando II * Nebulan Grando II

Grando Series is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a Meredith & Co. Gatling Gun. It is obtained as a reward for completing the Normal Mission Frontier Spirit. The Grando weapons available in-game are: * Storm Grando * Soldier Grando * Warrior Grando * Ophidian Grando * Destroyer Grando * Striker Grando * Delta Grando * Cosmic Grando * Nebulan Grando

The Greedy Millesaur (Japanese: , Gurīdo Mirezauro) is a Mission Exclusive Enemy in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a Millesaur fought at level 17 at River Isle in Oblivia during the Squad Mission Hunting the Headless. It is encountered with its neck destroyed, similar to Gradivus, the Headless Emperor.
HP Recovery Down is a stat debuff in Xenoblade Chronicles X. HP Recovery Down reduces the effectiveness of healing from Battle Arts, Soul Voices, and passive HP regeneration.
H-Missiles are shoulder weapons for Skells in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from MG062: Megisia or by destroying Galdrs' weapon appendages.

Great Wall Tunnel No. 8 (Japanese: , Kyodai Bōheki: Dai-8 Ton'neru) is a landmark in . It is located on the Streets of the Land of Morytha, between the Collapsed Roadway, Evacuation Center and Wastes of Hubris. A terminal here offers a quest, making it, briefly, the only NPC in the Land of Morytha other than Traveling Bards.

Growing Up is a Heart-to-Heart in . It is located on the eastern side of the Ansel Hatchery in Fonsett Waters of the Leftherian Archipelago. It is also a prerequisite for Poppi QT's upgrade quest Powered-Up Poppi. Additionally, viewing this Heart-to-Heart is required to unlock Poppi QT's level 4 "Flash Counter" Battle Skill.

The Grambl Tirkin (Japanese: , Ganba Tākin) are four Quest-Exclusive Enemies in . They are members of the Tirkin family and are fought at level 14 on Melnath's Shoulder in the Upper Level - Left of the Gormott Province during Star-Crossed Lovers.

Graveside Flowers is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Leftherian Archipelago by talking to Trito at the Oratory Knoll Cemetery, when the nation has at least 1 star in Development Level. The time required to complete this mission is 30 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 7 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Botany" and "Kind Soul" Field Skills.

Greedy Monster is an Info Item in . It can be obtained after Chapter 3 by speaking to Razzlydazzly in the Argentum Trade Guild, by purchasing it from the Informant shop at the Goldmouth Flight Deck in the Argentum Trade Guild, by purchasing it from the Informant shop at the Kedeigh Gate of Alba Cavanich in the Empire of Mor Ardain, or by purchasing it from the Informant at the Plaza of Reprieve of Garfont Village in the Kingdom of Uraya. After obtaining this information, there is a chance that the Gluttonous Marrin will appear when Salvaging near Chansagh Wastes on the Lower Level of Mor Ardain.

In , they cause the wearer to begin a battle with their Master Arts partially or fully charged, and in they have the same effect for Ouroboros Powers. They are the upgraded version of the Wind Bracelet accessory. The legendary variant can be obtained from Profound Hodzuki.
The Grubby Painting is a Key Item in . It is a spoiled painting that was taken by Colony 0, and is given to the party during Acknowledging Feelings in order for it to be cleaned in the City.
Gyreflow (Japanese: ) is a Battle Art in . It is a variant of Moondog that can only be used by Isurd.

Grippen Vollgulls are Normal Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Vollgull family, and can be found at level 45 at the Argan Cathedral Ruins and on Kana Peak on the Black Mountains during any weather except for Red Lightning.

Hell Raspberries (Japanese: , Heru Suwītī, Hell Sweetie) are collectables in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be found on Prison Island. According to their description, they are extremely hot and people who have eaten them sworn they have seen demonic visions. Five are required for A Maid's Concerns.

Hero Time (Japanese: , Yuuki damo) is one of Riki's arts in . It activates an aura that prevents tension loss for allies who are within 10 meters of Riki when the aura activates, and randomly raises one of Riki's stats (Strength, Ether, Agility, Physical Defence, or Ether Defence) by 75% – 156% (75% - 174% ).
Healing Energy (Japanese: , Hīru Baria) is one of Fiora's arts in . When this aura art is activated, all debuffs are removed and Fiora gains a Regenerate buff while the aura is active.

The Helas Pillar (Japanese: , Herasu no Hashira) is a location in . It is located on the first floor of Agniratha, north of the Dios Pillar. The Verification Device of the 2nd Control Platform at the top of the tower on 3F must be activated to complete Pillar Verification Devices and unlock the transporter to the Meyneth Shrine. A fire Ether Gear containing Strength Down IV and Initial Tension IV crystals can be found nearby. The Vagabond Allocer can also be found near the ether gear.

Hardheart Canyon (Japanese: , Mujō no Keikoku) is an area in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in eastern Sylvalum, near Lower Delusian Mountains, close to FN Site 416. It separates Delusians North Summit from Delusians South Summit.
Hard Backbones are materials in . They are dropped by Moramora and Paguls on Valak Mountain and can be traded for from Kurralth at Harict Chapel after completing Mechonis Core.
Hardhaigh Palace (Japanese: , Kōgū Hādasharu) is a level in . It is located in the Empire of Mor Ardain, and is the seat of power in Alba Cavanich. Niall resides here.
Hard Krabbles (Japanese: , Hādo Kuraibu) are enemies in . They are members of the Krabble family and can be found at level 34-44 on Lascham Island and Varnax's Plunge in the Gormott Province.

Heroic Edwin (Japanese: , Gōketsu no Sutorongu) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Garlus family, and can be found at level 44 at the Pillar City Ruins in the Kingdom of Tantal. It sits in a cave around the corner from the location where Incandescent Marcus is fought.

|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Harvest Necklaces (Japanese: , Hōjō no Kubikazari) are accessories in and . They increase the rate of healing of Recovery-type Arts by up to 14%, boosting their healing power. The Affection Necklace, Holy Necklace and Saint's Necklace accessories offer stronger instances of this equipment's effect.

Harvest Help (Japanese: , Shūkaku no Tetsudai) is a Merc Group mission in . It can be received in the Gormott Province by talking to Tataka on a roof above Torigoth Market, when the nation has at least 1 star in Development Level. The time required to complete this mission is 40 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 10 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Production Mastery", "Transport Mastery" and "Agronomy" Field Skills.

Heavy Angling is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Indoline Praetorium from Quisantro at the Refugee Campground, when the nation has at least 1 star in Development Level. After Chapter 8, it can also be received automatically from the Leftherian Archipelago; if the mission was already unlocked in Indol before that point, it will be transferred to Leftheria. The time required to complete this mission is 30 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 7 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Ichthyology" and "Mastery of Thunder" Field Skills.

|-|Aux Core = |-|Skill RAM/Upgrade = Helping Hand (Japanese: , Shien Jōzu) is an Aux Core or a Skill RAM/Upgrade in . It increases the duration of Blade Art buff effects by up to 50%. This boosts their duration from 15s to a maximum of 22.5s. It does not apply to Arts Plus, Absorb Damage, Debuff Cancel and Draw Aggro, since these Blade Arts do not have a duration. It will however apply to Nullify Reaction, making the reaction invulnerability period longer, and Critical Up, Accuracy Up, Recharge Boost and Back Attack Up, making their benefits last for a greater amount of time. The Skill RAM/Upgrade variants can be used to customize Poppi α, Poppi QT and Poppi QTπ as an Aux Core equivalent. __
Hamish is an NPC in . He is an Ardainian who can be found at Smùide Mountain in the Empire of Mor Ardain.

Healing Ring (Japanese: , hīringusākuru "Healing Circle") is a Talent Art in . It is the Talent Art of the Medic Gunner class. When used, the user places a green ring below them. This ring grants Regenerate to any allies standing inside of it.
Hazidazi is a Nopon NPC in . She can be found at the Corne Island Camp in Erythia Sea.
